name: @openwork-ee/headless-runner
description: Cheap headless agent sessions: OpenWork AI Gateway for the model, OpenWork MCP for tools, a small scratch filesystem, and optional kept files and a computer per conversation.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter "@openwork-ee/headless-runner^..." --if-present run build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && esbuild src/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist/server.js --external:@hono/node-server --external:@modelcontextprotocol/client --external:hono --external:zod --external:@openwork-ee/headless-computer --external:@vercel/blob
